overview: This batch finalizes the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the Monte Carlo convergence check for endgame stability, and compressing the colonist psychology state machine into a bit-packed structure to reduce memory footprint during long-running sessions.

tasks.title: Deterministic State Hashing for Save Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a FNV-1a 64-bit hash function for the final simulation state. Use constexpr where possible. The hash must be computed over the raw byte representation of the core state structs (Tick, ColonistCount, ResourceTotals). Ensure no heap allocations during hash computation. The function signature should be `constexpr uint64_t ComputeStateHash(const CoreState& state)`. Include a static assertion for struct size alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Identical states produce identical hashes across different compilations.
Unit tests verify hash stability for 1000 random states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save files are valid and prevents 'corrupted save' errors in long campaigns.

tasks.title: Monte Carlo Convergence Early-Exit Optimization
tasks.architectural_spec: Refactor the Monte Carlo simulation loop to support early exit based on variance threshold. Define a struct `MCResult` with `double mean`, `double variance`, and `uint32_t iterations`. Implement a `Converged` flag. The loop should break if `variance < epsilon` for 3 consecutive iterations. Use `std::numbers::pi` for constants. Ensure the loop is unrolled for small iteration counts (N<10).
acceptance_criteria: Simulation terminates early when variance stabilizes.
No dynamic memory allocation in the hot loop.
Variance calculation is numerically stable (Welford's algorithm).
Performance benchmark shows >15% speedup for stable states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster loading times and smoother frame rates during complex simulation steps.

tasks.title: Bit-Packed Colonist Psychology State
tasks.architectural_spec: Convert the `ColonistPsychology` struct to use bit-fields for compact storage. Fields: `mood` (3 bits), `energy` (5 bits), `hunger` (5 bits), `social_need` (3 bits). Total 16 bits. Provide inline getter/setter methods. Ensure the struct is `alignas(2)`. Add a `ToString()` method for debugging that formats the bits into a readable string without heap allocation (use `std::string_view` or fixed buffer).
acceptance_criteria: Debug string generation uses a fixed-size stack buffer.
All existing tests pass with the new layout.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Reduced memory usage allows for larger colony sizes without performance degradation.
